sentences.text: Notice has been served to the victim.

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.3/2024 registered at Police Station - Kindrai, District Seoni (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376, 376(2)(n), 506, 354, 354(D), 34 of IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act and 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2-v) and 3(2)(va) of SC/ST Act.

Applicant is in detention since 08.05.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, allegation against the present applicant and other co-accused persons is of kidnapping the prosecutrix and committing sexual intercourse with her.
On the basis of said allegation, police registered the case against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in custody since 08.05.2024 and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
Age of the prosecutrix is 17 years, 10 months and 17 days on the date of incident.
It is further submitted that applicant has been made accused only on the basis of 2 MCRC-24587-2024 memorandum of co-accused Manish.
No sexual assault has been caused by the present applicant.
It is further submitted that no overt act has been done by the present applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal history of the applicant.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.

4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant on the ground that present applicant alongwith other co-accused persons kidnapped the minor prosecutrix at night from her house.
In Test Identification Parade, prosecutrix has identified the present applicant.
Therefore, he prayed for dismissal of this bail application.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case as well as looking to the seriousness of offence, it is not a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of Sanju Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52204013/
1 applicant, stands dismissed.
